scenes.text: Behind the paint lived a stained-glass lattice, intricate as a thought examining itself.
scenes.query: paint peeling from a wall to reveal a living kaleidoscopic lattice of sacred geometry, flowing neon veins, macro psychedelic motion

scenes.text: Then my body became transparent. Memories moved through me like colored fish beneath ice.
scenes.query: a translucent human silhouette containing schools of luminous memory-fish, frozen crystal surface dissolving into rainbow currents

scenes.text: My name slid away like a label falling from an ancient bottle.
scenes.query: an antique cosmic bottle floating over a black ocean as its paper label peels away and becomes a flock of glowing moths

scenes.text: It was not looking at the universe. The universe was looking through it.
scenes.query: a cosmic eye becoming a telescope through which stars, oceans, cities, and cells observe one another in recursive motion

scenes.text: I became a stranger on a train, carrying grief behind an ordinary face.
scenes.query: a commuter train folding through hyperspace, one passenger's face opening into a private storm of blue crystalline grief

scenes.text: I became a child discovering rain, an old woman forgetting home, and a bird turning sunlight into direction.
scenes.query: three-way psychedelic metamorphosis: child touching rainbow rain, elderly woman in a dissolving room, bird navigating solar ribbons

scenes.text: Each life arrived whole, a universe insisting with absolute sincerity that it was alone.
scenes.query: countless sealed glass universes floating in darkness, each containing a complete life and its own weather, drifting toward connection

scenes.text: Awareness moved through them like white light through stained glass, becoming every color yet belonging to none.
scenes.query: white consciousness-light passing through infinite stained-glass faces and exploding into rivers of impossible psychedelic color

scenes.text: There was no audience or performer. Only seeing, wearing distance as a magnificent disguise.
scenes.query: empty stage and audience dissolving into one fluid field of vision, velvet curtains becoming auroras and recursive tunnels

scenes.text: For one unbearable, beautiful instant, I was the eye behind every eye.
scenes.query: one radiant central eye connected to animals, strangers, ancestors, oceans, and stars by pulsing neural threads

scenes.text: But the experience did not tell me that differences were meaningless. It showed me why they mattered.
scenes.query: one beam entering a many-sided prism and emerging as distinct living worlds, each color preserving its own shape

scenes.text: A window does not betray the light by giving it a particular view.
scenes.query: a corridor of windows opening onto radically different psychedelic landscapes while one golden light passes through all of them

scenes.text: Pain was still pain. A boundary was sacred. No revelation gave cruelty permission to call itself unity.
scenes.query: a protective circle of luminous geometry holding back a chaotic red storm while a tender flame remains safe within

scenes.text: I understood: the witness cannot stand in front of itself. It can only become another view.
scenes.query: a faceless observer stepping through its own reflection and emerging as landscapes, creatures, and distant civilizations

scenes.text: Trying to find the final observer was like asking a flashlight to illuminate the source of its own beam.
scenes.query: a flashlight beam curving backward through fractal space, endlessly searching for its glowing source inside itself

scenes.text: Perhaps I was never a prisoner behind my eyes. I was an aperture through which existence became personal.
scenes.query: human eyes transforming into a camera aperture that opens onto an intimate universe of homes, hands, stars, and memories

scenes.text: Every argument became light disagreeing with itself after passing through different prisms.
scenes.query: two opposing rainbow beams arguing as animated geometric waves before tracing back to one white source

scenes.text: Compassion was not pity. It was the nervous system of existence recognizing one of its distant signals.
scenes.query: a cosmic nervous system spanning cities and forests, distant points awakening together with electric floral pulses

scenes.text: When I returned, my body felt heavy and astonishing. Even my hands seemed like ancient instruments I had borrowed.
scenes.query: hands returning from rainbow transparency into warm physical form, surrounded by fading constellations and intricate glyphs

scenes.text: I no longer wondered whether I was alone. I wondered whether solitude was the universe closing one eyelid so it could dream through the other.
scenes.query: the universe as two immense gentle eyes, one closing into starry sleep while the other dreams the viewer into existence
